name: AMD
summary:
AMD’s arrow mark is the tab icon on amd.com. It is the corporate site’s favicon, not a Ryzen or Radeon product badge, unless that is what the host file contains.

Checked 12 November 2026 against amd.com. HTML came from https://www.amd.com/en.html (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.amd.com/content/dam/code/images/favicon/favicon.ico; shortcut icon → https://www.amd.com/content/dam/code/images/favicon/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.amd.com/content/dam/code/images/favicon/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16.
